summary: Assist to Vail Mountain Rescue with a search for two missing male hikers on Mount of the Holy Cross
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group (lead) + Alpine Rescue Team (assist) + Army National Guard helicopter (Gypsum HAATS)
notes: Alpine 2016 Missions PDF item 16-142.; Vail Mag 40th-anniversary feature (2017-06): the two missing male hikers were teens from Colorado Springs who summited via the Cross Couloir ~7 p.m. just before Thanksgiving, got caught in a blizzard, and hunkered overnight shivering at 13,800 ft on the north ridge; a fixed-wing wildfire-monitoring plane's remote sensing followed their footprints to coordinates relayed to an Army National Guard helicopter (Gypsum HAATS), which hoisted them to safety — mission coordinator Scott Sutton: "they were literally 15 minutes from death." Run 509 UN merge (URL opened this run): pair identified as Tommy Hendricks, 18, and Matt Smith, 17, Colorado Springs students; summited ~7 p.m., spent two frigid nights out in whiteout conditions and ~7-degree temps; spotted by plane following their footprints ~4,000 ft below and a few miles from the summit; 35 rescuers plus airplane and Colorado Army National Guard Black Hawk; briefly hospitalized, released with minor frostbite on toes.
